function.name: historical_event_get_date
function.description: Retrieve the date of a specific historical event. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_name.description: The name of the historical event.

event_location.description: The location of the historical event.

event_time_period.description: The historical time period during which the event took place. (e.g., Renaissance, Middle Ages, etc.)

message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who signed the declaration of independence?" They want the list of signers. We can use the function to retrieve the date of a specific historical event. But we need the names of signers. The function only returns date. So we cannot get signers via function. We should answer directly. Provide list of signers. Probably mention that 56 delegates signed. Provide names. Let's provide a concise answer.
